title: The Rise of Agentic AI: How AI Agents Are Changing How We Work

slides.heading: The Rise of Agentic AI
slides.body: How autonomous AI agents are transforming the way we work — and what it means for you

slides.heading: What Is an AI Agent?
slides.body: An AI agent is software that can perceive its environment, plan a sequence of steps, and take actions to achieve a goal — all without constant human input. Unlike a chatbot that answers one question at a time, an agent pursues multi-step tasks on its own.

slides.heading: From Assistants to Autonomous Workers
slides.body: Early AI tools were reactive: you asked, they answered. Agentic AI is proactive — it browses the web, writes code, sends emails, and manages files. In 2026, agents routinely handle entire workflows that once required hours of human effort.

slides.heading: The Tools Agents Use
slides.body: Agents gain power through tools: web search, code execution, file systems, APIs, and even other AI models. By chaining these capabilities, a single agent can research a topic, draft a report, and schedule a meeting — all in one run.

slides.heading: Multi-Agent Systems
slides.body: The most powerful setups use teams of specialized agents. An orchestrator agent breaks down a complex goal and delegates subtasks to expert sub-agents — each one focused on coding, design, data analysis, or communication. Think of it as a tiny AI workforce.

slides.heading: Real-World Impact Today
slides.body: Software engineers use coding agents that write, test, and debug code. Customer-service agents handle thousands of support tickets simultaneously. Research agents scan scientific literature and surface key findings in minutes — tasks that used to take days.

slides.heading: The Safety Challenge
slides.body: More autonomy means more risk. An agent that can send emails or execute code can also make costly mistakes. Researchers are working on guardrails: permission scopes, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and audit logs that let humans review what agents actually did.

slides.heading: New Jobs, New Skills
slides.body: Rather than eliminating jobs outright, agentic AI is reshaping them. 'Prompt engineering' is giving way to 'agent orchestration' — designing, evaluating, and supervising AI workflows. The highest-value skill is knowing when to trust the agent and when to intervene.

slides.heading: What Comes Next
slides.body: Researchers predict agents will soon operate continuously in the background — monitoring systems, flagging anomalies, and executing pre-approved actions 24/7. Personal AI agents may manage your calendar, finances, and health data with minimal daily input from you.

slides.heading: The Agentic Era Is Here
slides.body: AI agents are no longer science fiction — they're daily tools. Understanding how they work, what they can do, and where they need oversight is the essential literacy of 2026 and beyond.
